description:
CHERISE, the soul sensation, is a Soul Girl at heart with a bold Brit attitude, and she's ready to make her mark with her debut Album 'Calling', dropping Summer 2023. 

Including ‘Secrets’, the smooth R&B track co-written with Tobie Tripp, ‘Elixir’, inspired by the Pop and Jazz Music of Paris in the 1980’s & 2 Steppin’ blending mysticism with quirkiness. Calling is a debut that embodies all of CHERISE talents, her effortless irresistible vocals, alongside her honest, soulful song writing manage to be simultaneously both contemporary and timeless.

A truly multi-faceted artist, CHERISE is fast proving herself to be one of the most fiercely talented young musicians in the UK and has collaborated with Gregory Porter (Disney), Steam Down, Reuben James, Omar, Nubiyan Twist, including previous tours with Jamie Callum & Michael Kiwanuka. CHERISE will perform at Love Supreme, X The Tracks Festival and Montreux Jazz Festival this year. 
“one of the women raising the bar for Soul and Jazz in the UK' - CLASH MAGAZINE, Sept 2022
